verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents Scheduling Links, which let others book time on your calendars, so a booking embed is a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions embedding that booking page in a third-party site, inline, popup or floating widget modes, or a documented embed snippet. Shareable links are an adjacent feature, not the embed capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the booking experience in my own site — inline, popup, or floating widget — with a documented snippet
